method: Complete pinned editor read with blob verification. Revisited already-credited Script reader for cross-file control, without double credit. Original AST callbacks joined through compatible no-argument signal and fake stream.
findings: Finished screen text unconditionally says All went well. Editor override_script maps every script-finished signal to this screen. Original Script._read_chunk emits that same signal on EOF and GLib read error; linked callback controls reach finished in both cases.

Stream termination is not process exit confirmation: previously reviewed Script.run neither waits for exit here nor carries exit status in signal; stderr is silenced. No actual script failure or GTK rendering claimed by the fake-stream control.

Editor populates text buffer from script.read, but on_run_script_clicked calls script.run without reading modified text buffer back. Displayed edits and executed on-disk content can diverge; no actual execution was needed or performed.

RunningLabel sums stat sizes from reported lines before checking action success, skips keeping only and ignores stat errors. Displayed removed byte count is not verified freed storage, especially with aliases or failed actions.
Replay-finished subscription is conditional on runner identity, and callbacks do not check current runner generation. Old completion versus current editor state needs event-loop validation.
Fallback text-view constructor creates an independent buffer without explicitly attaching it to the returned view; actual fallback rendering remains unverified.
Script save delegates to runner.save and exits chooser immediately; no additional result validation occurs in this method. Dry run defaults enabled; no mutation was executed during review.

executed_control.scope: Original Script._read_chunk joined to original EditorView.override_script callback with compatible no-argument signal; fake stream only, no subprocess or mutation.

limits: No GUI runtime, filesystem removal, installed package or performance qualification.
